intent: Make the top-fold Close April CTA visibly functional and product-cohesive as an FD-001 close workload command on Oyatie Cloud.
product_direction: Oyatie will build a hyperscaler-grade cloud substrate and dogfood all FD-001 microservices as tenant workloads on that substrate. FD-001 product delivery remains the master-plan product goal; Oyatie Cloud is the substrate that proves the platform can host real production tenants.
implementation_summary: Added dynamic and SSR-static hero close proof strip tying April close to FD-001, Oyatie Cloud, REC-CLOSE-2026-04, cell-us-east-2, and local-only command state.
Converted the primary Close April CTA and new hero route buttons into data-bound local actions with selected-state feedback and visible hero status updates.
Hero actions route to Ledger Preview, Cloud Ops Cockpit, and Audit Ledger while preserving no-mutation boundaries.
Added responsive hero command layout and styling using existing command-surface tokens.

visual_verdict.reasoning: The top-fold hero now makes the primary Close April CTA visibly functional and ties the first screen to FD-001 close workload proof on Oyatie Cloud with explicit receipt, cell, local-only state, and routes.
differences: Close remains a local visual stage/route operation; no payroll, ledger, tax, workflow, mail, billing, deploy, or cloud mutation is wired.
suggestions: Future production wiring can attach the same hero actions to real close-package orchestration APIs.

commands.summary: ready-after-5s; transient empty replies immediately after restart

known_limits: Visual prototype only; hero close actions do not execute payroll close, ledger posting, tax filing, workflow execution, mail sends, billing, deploy, or cloud/provider mutations.
This slice improves the top-fold hero CTA; it does not prove the full dashboard/mockup objective complete.
